crops.name: Maize (mielies)
crops.storageConditions: Shelled grain dried to ≤14% moisture, kept in a clean sealed container or silo with active weevil/larger-grain-borer control.

crops.name: Dry beans (sugar beans)
crops.storageConditions: Fully dried grain (12-15% moisture), clean sealed containers, cool and dry, with bruchid/weevil control (e.g. edible-oil admix at 5ml/kg, or storage in-pod).

crops.name: Butternut
crops.storageConditions: Mature hard-rind fruit, cured, clean, dry, undamaged, kept ventilated at 10-15°C/50-70% RH.

crops.name: Pumpkin
crops.storageConditions: Mature, cured (hardened-skin) fruit, undamaged, kept ventilated at 10-15°C/50-70% RH.

crops.name: Onions
crops.storageConditions: Field-dried (cured, necks fully dry) bulbs held at ambient temperature in well-ventilated trays/racks.

crops.name: Sweet potato
crops.storageConditions: Only mature, undamaged roots; cured 30-32°C/85-90% RH for 4-7 days, then stored with minimal handling as cool as achievable (source optimum 13°C) at ~85-90% RH. The sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) is the main storage threat.

crops.name: Potato
crops.storageConditions: Cured 15-20°C/85-90% RH for 5-10 days, then kept dark and naturally ventilated averaging ~15°C or cooler, no sprout inhibitor.

crops.name: Amadumbe (taro)
crops.storageConditions: Cool, dry, well-ventilated storage at ambient 25-30°C — traditionally heaped corms under shade or covered with straw/plantain leaves.

crops.name: Groundnuts (peanuts)
crops.storageConditions: Unshelled (in-shell) pods dried to in-shell moisture ~10% or less, stored in gunny bags, mud bins, baskets or a ventilated dry room, protected from pests and damp.

crops.name: Garlic
crops.storageConditions: Well-cured bulbs (dried several weeks, dark/dry/ventilated), then kept unrefrigerated in a cool, dry, dark, well-ventilated place (e.g. mesh bags).
